chapter: Casa, Zeb Lenard and Little Joe
title: Zeb Lenard, Buddy Petit and George Lewis's early bands
summary: Vincent says Zeb worked with Buddy Petit and Jack, and that Petit left for Chicago. George Lewis worked with Vincent more than with any band and also with Petit and Kid Howard.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Ask him, who did Zeb work with?

Who did Zeb work with? Zeb? Buddy Petit, yeah. Zeb? When I was here. Were you working with Jack when Jack was working with him? No. He used to work with Jack. He stayed with kids with her a long time. And he stayed with Buddy. Me and him was the guy that was Buddy, you see. But Peter, he had left him there. He went to Chicago. He had to talk to Peter, eh? He had to get a little, little satin kind of, uh, the Peter couldn't read and lit. You know, I used to show him some time. But he told me, don't tell him fellas they didn't know how to read, you know.
Well, what about, uh, who did George Lewis work with other than him?

So, who did George Lewis work with in them times? He's a kid. He's a kid. He's a kid when he's coming out. My dear George worked- worked with me more than any band ever worked with. Now, of course, he'd been working with a different band, but now he got the band of his own. Used to work with Butter Petit too with me. That's how we worked with Kid Howard. And then I came to work with Kid Howard. Wasn't he working with Kid Howard once? And then Jim Crow. You got his name too? Oh yeah, I know him. He used to play with us after Freddie Babu. Freddie Babu stayed on his key chamber on Colón. And we were on that slide. So we got Jim Crow. And then when the band broke up, we got up again. Then we got Freddie was on the slide. Then we got Freddie back again. And then we got to go through. That's the end of the week.
